handoff.objective: Independently verify the INTEGRITY of the EXP-ISOU-2ac81f census run set produced by TASK-20260813-4bee82 -- run receipts, certificates, controls and reproducibility bindings -- and return PASS, REVISE or REJECT with blocking evidence. experiments/EXP-ISOU-2ac81f/runs/ -- the immutable run records under review

constraints: Review the artifacts as produced; recompute and re-derive from them rather than trusting producer summaries.
DO NOT RE-RUN THE EXPERIMENT and do not execute the solver; run no experiment and spend no census compute.

DO NOT INTERPRET. Do not state whether the hypothesis is supported or falsified, do not assign evidence strength, do not write or amend any ledger record, and do not change any status. Adjudicating integrity is the whole job.

CHECK THE DIFFERENT-ORDER NULL OBJECT ACTUALLY SEPARATED, at the resolution of the frozen seed band, for every run. IF IT DID NOT, NO Q1 OR Q3 RESULT MAY BE REPORTED FROM THAT RUN IN ANY FORM, including as preliminary or partial, and say so explicitly in the report.

CHECK THE CLASS WALK CLOSED ON h(disc(End(E_0))) RATHER THAN MERELY TERMINATING: confirm the enumerated vertex count and the independently computed class number are both reported and compared, and that h was computed independently of the walk. A walk that merely terminated is an incomplete subgraph and invalidates every no-member-is-cheaper statement.

CHECK Q1 AND Q2 WERE MEASURED IN THEIR SEPARATE COORDINATE REGIMES: Q1 with every member in the one declared common coordinate system and arithmetic implementation, Q2 with each member in its own cheapest reachable model from a candidate set and cost rule declared BEFORE measurement. Mixing them invalidates Q1 under the contract's own rules.

CHECK THE CERTIFICATE CHECKER SHARES NO STATE AND NO CODE PATH WITH THE SOLVER, by reading the implementation; self-confirmation is not verification. Confirm every claimed solve carries independent verification output and that any member without one contributes no cost datum and appears in the defect log.

Also check: expected run count against the contract's run accounting; schema-complete manifests including the resolved inference block; seed integrity and that the seed band was frozen before any between-member comparison; exact raw-versus-summary agreement; control comparability, meaning controls ran under identical solver parameters to the members they control; special-j segregation; deduplication by F_p-isomorphism; and that every walk-cost component entering Q3 is labelled measured or modelled with a recorded formula.
A timeout, crash, budget exhaustion or implementation failure is INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL and never a negative mathematical result; classify it as such and never as a slow or resistant curve.
Report defects concretely enough for the Executor to reproduce and repair them; an invalid or incomplete run set goes back to the Executor and is not evidence.
Independent session, review-adversarial. No fallback, no degradation, no Bedrock.
Write only the review report; commit nothing.
